description: 近景特写 rubric — faces, eyes, hands dominate; drift and anatomy are weighted up because the bible's 固定特征词 (eye color, scar) are fully visible.

axes.label: 面部一致性 (eyes / scar / hair vs bible)
checks: 银灰色眼睛 exactly matches the locked reference eye color
左眉伤疤 present, same side and position as the reference

axes.label: 面部 / 手部解剖
checks: facial features symmetric and undistorted at close range

axes.label: 情绪兑现 (delivery_promise, close-up)
checks: the micro-expression sells the dialogue beat (cold resolve), not a blank stare
eye-light / catchlight reads the intended emotion

axes.label: 无伪影 / 乱码
checks: no watermark, no garbled subtitle text burned in

axes.label: 风格底线
checks: noir rim light on the face; honors negative_floor

禁止变化项_hook: at 近景 the 固定特征词 are fully visible — any eye-color/scar/hair change => failure_mode=drift, drift=true
